sentence: On 19 October 2026 the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab (Jemperli, GSK).

sentence: It is approved for adults with stage II or III locally advanced rectal cancer whose tumours are mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H).

sentence: The FDA says the approval relied on interim results from AZUR-1, a single-arm, open-label study in patients with previously untreated dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer.
